summary: AI researcher and builder working on applied deep learning, most recently computer vision for agricultural disease detection. Software engineering graduate with a focus on evaluation that can be reproduced: documented data, honest splits, and results reported as they are.

thesisHighlights: Held the dataset, split, augmentation and training budget fixed for both backbones.
Fine-tuned DenseNet121 and EfficientNet-B0 from ImageNet weights.
Documented the protocol alongside the results so the comparison can be re-run.
Shipped the comparison as a Gradio app on Hugging Face for disease detection and advisory.
